title: Roamhaven Rewards Benefit for Hosts: Payout Methods Conversion Fee Discount
content:
A host who also travels with Roamhaven and holds an active Roamhaven Rewards membership receives a discount on the conversion fee charged on transfers to their Payout Methods paid in a currency other than USD. The discount follows the tier of the host's own active Rewards membership as a guest.

## Discount by Rewards tier

| The host's Roamhaven Rewards membership | Rewards discount on the conversion fee |
|---|---|
| Active, at Rewards Platinum, Rewards Diamond or Rewards Ambassador | 10% |
| Active, at Rewards Silver or Rewards Gold | 5% |
| Active, at Rewards Member | Nothing |
| No active membership (none held, or one that is pending confirmation, suspended or closed) | Nothing |

Only a membership whose status is active counts; its tier on the membership record decides the discount.

## Hypothetical cases

- An imagined host holds an active Rewards Gold membership: the conversion fee's Rewards discount is 5%.
- An imagined host holds a Rewards Diamond membership that is suspended: it is not an active membership, so there is no Rewards discount.
- An imagined host has never joined Roamhaven Rewards: no Rewards discount.

## Questions answered

- *Does the Rewards tier of a co-traveller count?* No. The discount reads the host's own active Rewards membership.
- *Is there a Rewards discount at the entry tier?* No. An active membership at Rewards Member carries nothing.
